UserWorkspaceSettings.title: UserWorkspaceSettings
UserWorkspaceSettings.description: Real-time persisted workspace preferences and selected Google Drive target folder for a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase UID of the workspace owner.

targetFolderId.description: Selected Google Drive folder ID, or empty string if unset.

targetFolderName.description: Display name of the selected Google Drive folder.

targetFolderWebLink.description: Optional Google Drive webViewLink URL for the target folder.

namingRule.description: Filename formatting rule applied when saving PDFs to Drive.

skipDuplicates.description: Whether to skip uploading PDFs already present in the target Drive folder.

botUsername.description: Connected Telegram bot public username without @.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace settings were created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace settings were last updated.

TelegramPdfRecord.title: TelegramPdfRecord
TelegramPdfRecord.description: Real-time record of a PDF document captured from Telegram and its Google Drive sync state.

ownerId.description: Firebase UID of the user who owns this PDF record.

pdfKey.description: Deterministic document key derived from chatId, messageId, and fileUniqueId.

chatTitle.description: Title of the Telegram chat, group, or channel.

senderName.description: Display name or handle of the Telegram sender.

fileId.description: Telegram file_id used for fetching the file.

fileUniqueId.description: Stable Telegram file_unique_id for duplicate detection.

postedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the PDF was posted on Telegram.

driveFileId.description: Google Drive file ID once uploaded, or empty string.

driveWebViewLink.description: Google Drive webViewLink URL once uploaded, or empty string.

uploadedFolderId.description: Google Drive folder ID where the file was saved, or empty string.

uploadedFolderName.description: Display name of the Google Drive folder where the file was saved.

uploadedAt.description: ISO timestamp when saved to Google Drive, or empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was last updated.

ActivityLogEntry.title: ActivityLogEntry
ActivityLogEntry.description: Immutable real-time audit log item for sync, upload, download, and folder actions.

ownerId.description: Firebase UID of the user who performed the action.

title.description: Short summary title for the activity entry.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the activity occurred.

AllowedEmailEntry.title: AllowedEmailEntry
AllowedEmailEntry.description: Admin-managed allowlist of Google email addresses permitted to access the application.

emailHash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the normalized email address.

status.description: Approval state of this email address.

note.description: Optional admin note for this user.

addedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the admin who created or updated this rule.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when email entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when email entry was last updated.

UserAccessEntry.title: UserAccessEntry
UserAccessEntry.description: Tracks signed-in users requesting or holding access approval from the Admin Panel.

uid.description: Firebase UID of the signed-in user.

email.description: Normalized lowercase email address of the user.

emailHash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the user's email address.

displayName.description: User display name from Google sign-in.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when access record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when access record was last updated.

/users/{userId}/pdfs/{pdfKey}.description: Stores real-time captured Telegram PDFs and Google Drive sync state per user.

/users/{userId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Stores real-time transfer activity logs per user.

/allowedEmails/{emailHash}.description: Admin-managed email allowlist for pre-approving or revoking user emails.

/userAccess/{userId}.description: Per-user access status and pending approval requests visible to the Admin Panel.
